root_cause.diagnosis: The performance wrapper attempted to rename zero-science main() with an outer main macro. The included zero-science source itself redefined main while including its runtime and then undefined main, so its standalone main() compiled normally and collided with the performance wrapper main().
compiler_evidence: error C2084: function 'int main(int,char **)' already has a body

repair.mechanism: Add ARCLLM_B1_2_EMBED_LIBRARY guard around only the standalone zero-science main(); performance wrapper defines that guard while including qualified helper/data-path code. Remove legacy outer main-renaming macro.

governance.reason: Exact source blobs changed, so immutable lock v0.1 must remain historical and a new v0.2 must bind the repaired wrapper sources.
